title: [Feature] Persist todos across reloads and keep the counter honest
body:
## User story

As someone keeping a working list, I want my todos to survive a page reload and the remaining-items counter to stay accurate, so that I can trust the app with real work.

## Context

The app currently holds todos in memory only, so a refresh wipes the list and the counter is the only thing that hints at state. This issue moves the list into browser storage and makes the footer (counter + filters) reflect reality at all times.

Scope is the single-page todo flow only: add, complete, reload, clear. Editing, drag-and-drop reordering and filtering are out of scope for this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: On a first load with empty storage, the todo list is empty and the footer (item counter and filter links) is not visible.
- [ ] AC2: Typing a todo into the "What needs to be done?" input and pressing Enter adds it to the list, and the footer shows exactly "1 item left".
- [ ] AC3: Adding a second todo updates the counter to "2 items left"; marking one of them complete brings the counter back to "1 item left".
- [ ] AC4: After a full page reload, the todos are still listed and a completed todo is still shown as completed.
- [ ] AC5: Clicking "Clear completed" removes the completed todos and leaves the remaining count correct.

## Notes for QA

- Test on a clean browser profile, with no prior localStorage for the app.
- The counter pluralises: "1 item left" for one, "2 items left" for more.
- Completed items are rendered with a strikethrough on the label.
